shared_data_policy: All compared generative methods use identical episode splits, window extraction, normalization, and goal relabeling for a task.

tasks.category_evidence: The existing data are strong but require an episode-level split and exclusion or explicit retention policy for two clipped simulator-state episodes.
tasks.dataset_version: carlq/ecdiffuser-data main; local SHA256 identifies the exact file
tasks.observations: DLP particles (48 x 10) plus state_observations (4 entities x 6); no RGB stored
tasks.proprioception: Panda planar end-effector state is entity 0 in state_observations
tasks.goals: Time-constant DLP and state goals for the three colored cubes
tasks.splits: No source split; deterministic episode-level train/validation split is required before final training
tasks.normalization: Repository ParticleGaussianNormalizer for DLP observations/goals and LimitsNormalizer for actions; fit on training data only in the final protocol
tasks.transformation: Retain source pickle; use an index/split manifest rather than duplicate 811 MB. Predeclare handling of episodes 54 and 1327, whose object states reach +/-1.1.

tasks.category_evidence: Official play data exist with a separate validation file, but transition streams require episodization and a frozen future-goal relabeling/window policy.
tasks.successful_vs_unsuccessful: Not an expert-success dataset: play trajectories press arbitrary buttons and are not collected for the five evaluation goals
tasks.observations: Benchmark state observation; visual counterpart is separate and not selected
tasks.proprioception: Included in benchmark state observation; qpos/qvel are also stored for replay
tasks.actions: 5-D continuous manipulation action, clipped to [-1, 1] by the official generator
tasks.goals: Future-state goals relabeled from trajectories for offline GCRL; five benchmark evaluation goals
tasks.normalization: To be fit on official training split only
tasks.transformation: Episodize on terminals, map future states to goal, preserve qpos/qvel and button_states, and emit fixed trajectory windows without modifying NPZ sources

tasks.category_evidence: The official file is presented as 1,000 successful generated demonstrations, but 16 episodes have zero stored reward throughout; quarantine them until replay verification. The remaining data require an episode split and zero-copy HDF5 adapter.
tasks.observations: Two 84x84 RGB views, 42-D object observation, robot joint/eef/gripper proprioception, relative object pose features, and 58-D simulator state
tasks.proprioception: Robot proprioception in robomimic observation groups
tasks.actions: Benchmark robosuite end-effector controller action; exact dimension and bounds must be read from env_args in HDF5
tasks.goals: Fixed task goal and task ID; no varying explicit goal vector in the released demonstrations
tasks.splits: No official train/validation/test split in the single HDF5 file; create deterministic episode-level split
tasks.transformation: Preserve HDF5 and env_args; map demo groups to episodes, retain simulator states and object observations, and encode the fixed goal/task ID

tasks.category_evidence: Official successful human demonstrations exist in task-level LeRobot form, but privileged state exclusion, an episode split, and task-goal encoding must be frozen.
tasks.license: MIT dataset; third-party assets retain their licenses
tasks.observations: Two 640x640 RGB video streams plus 23-D policy state
tasks.visual_observations: random_camera and wrist, AV1 at 30 FPS
tasks.proprioception: 23-D single-arm policy state; official slice removes privileged task state
tasks.goals: Fixed language/task goal: hammer the nail; no per-episode continuous goal vector
tasks.splits: Official file declares train episodes 0:100 only; create deterministic episode-level validation split
tasks.normalization: Official stats.json is available, but final comparison must recompute training-split-only statistics
tasks.transformation: Use the official converter semantics (action_rotvec, state[:23]); preserve videos, episode indices, timestamps, and task metadata

deferred.reason: Legacy checkpoint transfer was 0/16 because the visual/DLP domain shifted. New demonstrations are required if the migrated simulator becomes a paper benchmark; no expert or collection run is authorized yet.
Not selected for the compact first suite: it adds CoppeliaSim/PyRep compatibility cost and overlaps the long-horizon imitation role covered by MimicGen.

expert_rl.reason: Every proposed native-simulator task has official demonstrations. Training an RL expert would add cost and a data-quality confound without necessity.

downloads_performed.scope: single official HDF5 including low-dimensional data and two RGB views
state/action Parquet and metadata only; camera MP4 files excluded

compute_gate: Dataset adapters and <=1000-step pilots approved; no run over two GPU-hours without measured pilot estimate and explicit report.
